read.en: SanDisk fell 5.6% on Nov 13 to $885.01, trading $848.50–939.53. It is below the 5-day ($909.3), 10-day ($942.7), 30-day ($1,260.1) and 100-day ($1,501.8), all falling, and the rising 200-day ($1,282.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2, below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($1,137.83), and RSI is 33.9.
read.zh: 闪迪 11月13日下跌 5.6%，收于 $885.01，盘中区间 $848.50–939.53。股价位于 5 日（$909.3）、10 日（$942.7）、30 日（$1,260.1）和 100 日均线（$1,501.8）下方，四者均在下行，同时位于上行的 200 日均线（$1,282.4）下方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄、接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$1,137.83），RSI 为 33.9。

read.en: The close lost the $920–947 band and the $899–915 zone (5-day, Nov 6–10 highs), now resistance; the $848.50 low undercut $860–870 before the close recovered. Resistance is $899–915, then $920–947 and $953–978. Support is $860–870, then $835–848.5 (Nov 6 close, Nov 13 low) and $804–806 (Nov 5). A close above $915 would target $940–947; below $860, $835–848.
